name: Tubal-Cain
title: The First Smith
summary: Tubal-Cain was a descendant of Cain and the son of Lamech and Zillah. He is known as the first to forge tools from bronze and iron and is regarded in the Bible as the originator of metalworking. He represents technological development in the lineage of Cain.

keyEvents.title: The Birth and Work of Tubal-Cain
keyEvents.description: Tubal-Cain was born as the son of Lamech and his second wife Zillah. He became the first to forge all kinds of tools from bronze and iron.

keyEvents.title: Cain's Lineage
keyEvents.description: Tubal-Cain is part of Cain's lineage described in Genesis. This lineage is characterized by cultural and technological development, but also by increasing sin and violence.

keyEvents.title: Lamech's Song of Violence
keyEvents.description: Tubal-Cain's father Lamech sang a song to his wives Adah and Zillah about violence and revenge, illustrating the moral decay in Cain's lineage where Tubal-Cain grew up.

keyEvents.title: Sister Naamah
keyEvents.description: Tubal-Cain's sister Naamah is mentioned by name, which is unusual in early genealogies and may suggest she held special significance.

keyEvents.title: The Beginning of Civilization in Cain's Line
keyEvents.description: Tubal-Cain and his brothers Jabal and Jubal together represent the origins of various crafts and cultures: Jabal was the ancestor of nomads, Jubal of musicians, and Tubal-Cain of smiths.
